column4: cleat#3245 B1b: engine/a_payload_write_leaves_the_instance_copy_untouched_test.go opens a *PostgresStore via newRunTestStore (testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres)) and reads workflow_instances against workflow_payloads, which exists only on PostgreSQL. multi-db/mysql sets CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so this one test skips.
